BiblicalUsage: Zithri is a son of Uzziel, named once in the genealogy of the Levites before the Exodus. He is a cousin of Aaron and Moses, and his name stands in the record of the family that will carry the priesthood. Nothing more is told of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zithri is remembered because the priestly line is counted before it is called, and God knows His servants by name.
